description: Subscribe an email address to The notacompany newsletter, Tiago's newsletter: the startups VCs just backed, curated by Tiago. Five minutes every weekday to see where tech is heading. Call it only with an address its owner asked you to sign up. It sends that address a confirmation link, and the subscription starts only when its owner clicks it (double opt-in), so tell them to look for the email from Tiago Martins. The answer is the same whether or not the address was already on the list. The RSS feed at https://www.notacompany.com/archive/rss needs no email at all.

email.description: The address to send the confirmation link to, given by its owner.
